updates.summary: One review nails it as "brutal, stylish, and cool," but also quieter and sadder than that sounds. It has killer action craft, yet the thing that lingers is the loneliness underneath all that steel-eyed control.
updates.good_pick_if: You want hard-edged action with real atmosphere and a wounded center.
updates.maybe_skip_if: You want levity or a revenge movie that is less bruised and introspective.

updates.summary: The fun of it is that it makes time-travel chaos feel "fast, bold, and surprisingly smart." It is sillier and busier than the first movie, but that maximal sequel energy is exactly why it plays so well with a lively room.

updates.maybe_skip_if: You want cleaner plotting or less manic sequel energy.

updates.maybe_skip_if: You want emotional subtlety or action with less ritualized brutality.

updates.maybe_skip_if: You want nuance over slogans or action over speeches.

updates.maybe_skip_if: You want psychological depth over speed, motion, and survival drive.
